_help: Marquee ('superstar') Indian investors tracked from their Screener.in shareholder pages (screener.in/people/<id>/). Each entry: display name + the Screener people id(s). An investor can have several name variants on Screener (self / HUF / firm / spouse) that each hold different stocks — list them all in 'ids' and they're merged under the one name. Fetched from your logged-in session via fetch-investors.bat.
